profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker PEGA. On its website the company describes itself as a leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, saying that organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. It says it has served large organizations since 1983.

The site presents Pega AI as grounded in best practices with governance built in, and describes AI agents that operate with context, compliance, and human oversight. It names Pega Platform as the product that unifies AI for mission-critical work and Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together. The company says its platform is intended to keep mission-critical operations governed, scalable, and adaptable.

The record held on the company lists no lawsuits and no MCP servers, and no products are tracked for it. Its profile lists Massachusetts as a jurisdiction of law exposure, with a count of 191, and gives a CIK of 0001013857.
